# Extract shared LLM caller module (llm.js)

**Goal.** Extract the existing `callLlm` function from `generate-changelog.js` into a new shared module `skill/ship/scripts/llm.js` so it can be imported by `discord-notify.js` (which must **not** import `generate-changelog.js` due to its `git rev-parse` at module import time).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **New module.** `skill/ship/scripts/llm.js` exports `callLlm(messages, opts)` with the same signature, logic, and graceful `null` fallback as the existing inline implementation in `generate-changelog.js`.
- **Import updated.** `generate-changelog.js` imports `callLlm` from `llm.js` instead of defining it inline; no other behaviour changes.
- **Graceful fallback.** `callLlm` returns `null` when `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is absent or the API call fails (unchanged semantics).
- **No new dependencies.** Only Node.js 18+ built-ins (`fetch`, `AbortSignal`).
- **Tests.** Unit tests in `tests/unit/test-llm.mjs` (mirrored to `skill/ship/tests/test_llm.mjs`) verify: null on missing key, null on API error, successful response path.

## Deliverables

- `skill/ship/scripts/llm.js` (new)
- `generate-changelog.js` (import update — inline `callLlm` removed)
- `tests/unit/test-llm.mjs` + mirrored test

## Dependencies

- None (foundation module)

## Key Files

- `skill/ship/scripts/llm.js` — new shared module
- `skill/ship/scripts/release/generate-changelog.js` — import update
- `tests/unit/test-llm.mjs` — unit tests
- `skill/ship/tests/test_llm.mjs` — mirrored tests

## Risks

- None — pure refactor with identical semantics; low risk.

# Release focus generation in changelog

**Goal.** Extend `generate-changelog.js` to generate a 1–3 sentence release focus paragraph via the LLM and persist it as a machine-extractable marker under the version heading.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Focus generation.** `generate-changelog.js` requests a 1–3 sentence summary of the release's main focus from the LLM, informed by the categorised work items (features, bug fixes, other).
- **Marker persistence.** The focus is written as `> **Release focus:** …` as the first line directly under the `## vX.Y.Z (date)` heading in the generated CHANGELOG section.
- **Omission on failure.** When the LLM is unavailable (no API key, network error), the marker is omitted and the changelog section is produced as before.
- **No behavioural regression.** Other changelog content (feature/bug-fix/other sections) is unchanged.
- **Tests.** Unit tests verify: marker present when LLM succeeds, marker absent when LLM fails, marker content is 1–3 sentences, existing changelog structure preserved.

## Deliverables

- `generate-changelog.js` (modified)
- `tests/unit/test-generate-changelog-focus.mjs` — new tests
- `skill/ship/tests/test_generate_changelog_focus.mjs` — mirrored tests

## Dependencies

- SA-0MUVV6DK0002ISW4 (llm.js extract — provides `callLlm`)

## Key Files

- `skill/ship/scripts/release/generate-changelog.js` — focus generation + marker
- `skill/ship/scripts/llm.js` — imported callLlm
- `tests/unit/test-generate-changelog-focus.mjs` — unit tests
- `skill/ship/tests/test_generate_changelog_focus.mjs` — mirrored tests

## Risks

- LLM focus may be bland or miss the headline change. Mitigation: bounded length, config-driven overrides as future work.

data.description:
## Summary

The audit runner cannot re-audit an item in the terminal `completed`/`done` state: its entry status lifecycle unconditionally claims the item with `wl update <id> --status in_progress` (no `--stage`), and the worklog rejects `in-progress`/`done` as an incompatible status/stage pair.

## Evidence

Reproduced from a clean checkout against a scratch item:

```text
$ wl update <done-item> --status in_progress --json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Invalid status/stage combination: status \"in-progress\" is not compatible with stage \"done\". Allowed stages for status \"in-progress\": intake_complete, plan_complete. Allowed statuses for stage \"done\": completed, deleted."
}
```

The ContextHub compatibility guard (`isStatusStageCompatible`) only whitelists the audit-runner transitional pair for `in-progress` with `in_review`, `idea`, `intake_complete`, and `plan_complete` — not `done`.

This blocks parent SA-0MUJNZ5RN0078B5M AC4: re-auditing the already-`done` SA-0MUIA3OE40001QJX (child SA-0MUKCOX3T0057ES6, which forbids reopening the item).

## Desired behaviour

Re-auditing a `completed`/`done` item must work without reopening it. A `done` item is already terminal, so the runner must not attempt the invalid `in-progress`/`done` claim; it should run the audit and let the verdict-driven terminal lifecycle keep/restore `done` (Yes), demote to `open`/`plan_complete` (No), or restore `completed`/`done` (failure).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `cmd_issue` does not issue an invalid `--status in_progress` claim for a `completed`/`done` item.
- [ ] Regression test: auditing a `completed`/`done` item with a `Ready to close: Yes` report completes without the invalid claim and leaves the item `completed`/`done`.
- [ ] Regression test: a `Ready to close: No` re-audit of a `done` item demotes it to `open`/`plan_complete`.
- [ ] Regression test: an infra failure on a `done` item restores `completed`/`done`.
- [ ] Existing lifecycle tests remain green; full suite green.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` (`cmd_issue` entry claim, `_apply_terminal_lifecycle`)
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_lifecycle.py`

## Dependencies

- Blocks SA-0MUKCOX3T0057ES6 (re-audit SA-0MUIA3OE40001QJX).
- discovered-from:SA-0MUJNZ5RN0078B5M.
data.title: Audit runner cannot re-audit a completed/done item (in-progress/done claim rejected)

## TDD evidence + implementation

**Root cause confirmed:** the entry lifecycle in `_phase_gate` unconditionally ran `wl update <id> --status in_progress`. For a `completed`/`done` item the worklog rejects that claim: `Invalid status/stage combination: status "in-progress" is not compatible with stage "done"`.

**Red (before fix)** — `python3 -m pytest skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_lifecycle.py -k TestDoneItemReaudit -q`:

```
RuntimeError: wl command failed (wl --worklog-dir ... update TEST-1 --status in_progress --json):
Invalid status/stage combination: status "in_progress" is not compatible with stage "done".
4 failed, 41 deselected
```

**Fix:** skip the `in_progress` claim when the captured `original_stage == "done"` (a done item is terminal; there is nothing to claim). The verdict-driven terminal lifecycle already handles `done` on exit (Yes keeps `done`; No demotes to `open`/`plan_complete`; failure restores `completed`/`done`).

**Green (after fix):** `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_lifecycle.py` 45 passed; full `skill/audit/tests/` 1164 passed, 2 skipped; `ruff check` clean.

**Files:** `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` (entry claim guard), `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_lifecycle.py` (`TestDoneItemReaudit`), `skill/audit/SKILL.md` (lifecycle bullet).
